quam reliqui Troade apud Carpum, veniens affer tecum,
bring with you the supplies that I left with Carpus at Troas,
Alexander ærarius multa mala mihi ostendit:
Alexander the coppersmith has shown me much evil;
reddet illi Dominus secundum opera ejus:
the Lord will repay him according to his works.
And you should also avoid him;
for he has strongly resisted our words.
In prima mea defensione nemo mihi affuit,
At my first defense, no one stood by me,
sed omnes me dereliquerunt: non illis imputetur.
but everyone abandoned me. May it not be counted against them!
But the Lord stood with me
so that through me the preaching would be accomplished,
and so that all the Gentiles would hear.
et liberatus sum de ore leonis.
And I was freed from the mouth of the lion.
Liberavit me Dominus ab omni opere malo:
The Lord has freed me from every evil work,
et salvum faciet in regnum suum cæleste,
and he will accomplish salvation by his heavenly kingdom.
To him be glory forever and ever.

and all the brothers greet you.
